cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apologise for announcing I baked the cake before judging. I taught you to present numbered plates so nobody started with a favourite.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'another interesting attempt' before anyone tasted it. Clear diction, at least; now apologise for telling them what to expect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges to doubt my cake before they tasted it. That isn't the neutral introduction I taught you.

reason: Apply the specific final dialogue edit found on rereading: remove duplicated explanations, simplify a tangled teacher reminder, make the witnessed endpoint direct, or ask for the exact unfairness apology with explicit baker identification.
